content: How many credits are you taking this semester?
I have to have at least eighteen to keep my scholarships and grant. But so far, I only have fifteen.
What's the matter, are the classes you want full?
Yes. And now I'm down to either taking a class I'm not going to need or considering a double major.
If you were to take on a double major, what would be your first choice?
I think with International Business a language would be appropriate.
Have you even thought that far ahead? I mean what country would you like to do business with?
As a matter of fact, I would like to work in South America. So some Latin language like Spanish or Portuguese would work.
